feature_selection.policy: maximum absolute calibration median shift divided by normal standard deviation

reporting_boundary: Applicability routing uses normal training and abnormal calibration partitions only. Held-out normal and abnormal evaluation statistics are post-hoc transfer diagnostics and must not be used for feature selection, model selection, thresholds, or adaptation. Thresholds are engineering routing beacons to be validated by multi-dataset ablation, not universal statistical constants.
